editor.reignofnether.blocks.tip.var_remo: Takes from a variable (a vanilla scoreboard).
editor.reignofnether.blocks.tip.obj_add: Shows in the Objectives panel at the top right. Goal 0 has no count, it's just done or not.
editor.reignofnether.blocks.tip.obj_prog: Counts toward the goal; it's done when it reaches it.
editor.reignofnether.blocks.tip.timer: A countdown at the top of everyone's screen, then runs the file. bossbar remove reignofnether:timer/<id> stops it.
